'''Rakott krumpli''' is a popular Hungarian potato casserole.

==Ingredients==
* 6 medium [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Hard Boiled Eggs|hard boiled eggs]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* 1 ''kolbász'' (Hungarian [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausage]]) or 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] diced [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]] (optional)
* 4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 350 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] sour cream around 40% fat (called ''tejföl'' or ''smetana'')

==Procedure==
# Cook the potatoes for about 15–20 minutes.
# Peel the potatoes and the eggs.
# Slice the potatoes, eggs, and sausage.
# Put a little olive oil in a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]]. Arrange alternating layers of potatoes, eggs, and salt or sausage in the dish.
# Drizzle olive oil over the filling, and top with sour cream.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a preheated [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 200°C for about 35 minutes.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Traditionally most Hungarian cooking used lard (preferably home-made) but olive oil works just as well as a substitution.
